WHY DOES IT HAPPEN?

1. Discount

Does a bigger discount mean less profit?

Profit at each discount level

Bars above the line make money, bars below lose it. Watch where the bars cross zero.

The deeper the discount, the lower the margin

Each dot is one product. Blue makes money, red loses it. The red line shows the trend. A few extreme products are drawn at the bottom edge.

2. Shipping cost

Is delivery eating the profit in some markets?

What each dollar of sales pays for

Every bar is 100% of sales. If shipping were the problem, the orange part would be much bigger in the weak markets.
Products and other costsShippingProfit

Shipping cost against margin, by country

Each dot is a country, coloured by market, sized by sales. A country in the red corner would pay a lot to ship and still lose money.

A few causes make most of the loss
